For T2, predict 4 units at ticks 3 through 6 and release by 9. Ordinary clip alternative: install C at 0, remove C at 7; predict the same retention with two actions and zero impacts. One action per tick completes next boundary. Keep b=2 and all hard requirements unchanged. No Q assumption, outside support, pin/non-pin combination or heldout access. Root replays the three saved lists.
